subtitle: Lesson 32 · Update Sets & Change Management (Admin View)

eyebrow: Three real problems Preview can surface

steps.label: Collision
steps.sub: target's version differs from the Update Set's version -- usually a direct edit on the target

steps.label: Missing dependency
steps.sub: references something (e.g. a Script Include) not yet on the target instance

steps.label: Skipped record
steps.sub: an admin deliberately chose not to apply one flagged change during Preview

code:
Preview flags a collision:
  Update Set's version  vs.  target's current version

Fix: review BOTH versions side by side
  -> deliberately choose which to keep
  -> never let either side win by default
caption: A collision needs a decision, not an accident.

eyebrow: Missing dependency -- prevent, don't just fix
code:
Update Set A: new Business Rule
  calls Script Include from Update Set B

Commit A before B -> Rule calls something
  that, from the target's view, doesn't exist

Fix: commit B (the dependency) BEFORE A
caption: Correct dependency order prevents most missing-dependency problems before they happen.

code:
Skipped record:
  an admin, during Preview, deliberately
  chose NOT to apply one flagged change

Fix: document what was skipped and why
  -> revisit on purpose
  -> a forgotten skip can leave later Update
     Sets assuming something was applied
     that actually wasn't
caption: Unlike a collision or a missing dependency, this one is a human decision.

subtitle: A worked scenario: building, moving, and resolving a real collision.
